toolsPanel.title: Tools panel
toolsPanel.text: This panel contains all available image editing tools. You can select a tool to apply various modifications. Each tool may also provide additional settings and options.

topPanelLeft.title: File Management
topPanelLeft.text: This section allows you to view and edit the file name, open a new image file, or close the current one.

topPanelCenter.title: Editing Controls
topPanelCenter.text: Here you can undo or redo changes, as well as zoom in or out to adjust your view of the image.

topPanelRight.title: Help & Settings
topPanelRight.text: This area provides access to the help section,  and editor configuration settings.

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.text: This is the main editing area where the image is displayed. You can interact with the image directly here using various tools. You can also turn on rulers in the settings to help with precise editing.

toolSettings.title: Tool Settings
toolSettings.text: This section displays the settings for the currently selected tool. You can adjust parameters specific to the tool you are using.

exportTool.title: Export Tool
exportTool.text: This tool allows you to save your edited image in various formats. You can choose the desired format and quality before exporting.

dragDropArea.title: Drag and Drop Area
dragDropArea.text: You can drag and drop an image file here to open it in the editor. This is a quick way to start editing without using the file menu.
